a.name: Kennel ledger
a.description: The six as ruled rows, square photo left, price right, brass Ask pill; boys and girls as two ruled columns from 1024px.
a.differs_from: Image-left rows grouped by sex and framed by rules; the built puppy sections are imageless card grids or a rail on a band.

b.name: Contact sheet
b.description: Six prints on a sunk steel-100 tray: 4:5 photo, bone mount with name, brass price tag, Available and a stretched Ask link.
b.differs_from: A three-up grid like S1, but photo-topped prints sunk in an inset tray rather than plain cards on the page; differs on media and framing.

c.name: Litter wall
c.description: An edge-to-edge photo mosaic, Cheryl on a double square; a bone plate at each tile's foot names, prices and links the puppy.
c.differs_from: Photos are the tiles themselves in a full-bleed mosaic of mixed sizes; the built sections are even card grids or a rail on a band.
